defaults.dark: It is pitch black. Something down here does not want to be seen.

rooms.name: The Porch
rooms.prose: Paint curls off the boards. The front door stands open behind you; ahead, a cellar door lies flat against the ground.

rooms.name: The Hall
rooms.prose: A narrow hall, papered in a pattern that was probably flowers. A hook by the door holds nothing. A side table does.

rooms.name: The Cellar
rooms.prose: Earth floor, stone walls, and a smell like old coins. Something glints in the corner.

items.name: iron key
items.roomProse: An iron key lies on the side table.

items.name: lantern
items.roomProse: A lantern hangs from the hook after all, half-hidden by the door.

items.name: silver locket
items.roomProse: A silver locket lies half-buried in the earth.

do.text: The key turns with a sound like a cough. The cellar door swings up and back.
It is locked, and you have nothing to turn.
The lantern catches, and the dark backs off a step.
You grope in the dark and find only cold earth.
You lift the locket. It is warm, which it should not be.

You climb back into the light holding something that was waiting for you.

*** You have won ***
The lantern gutters once and goes out.
